title: Chapter 305: The Final Battle In The Desert
content:
Chapter 305: The Final Battle In The Desert

Wu Qing now has a lot of resources in his hands. As long as he invests in a battlefield, he will be able to quickly end a war.

Wu Qing first ruled out the war with the alien race. The alien race is a super tribe in the evil god camp and the most uncontrollable. It is best to wait until the Zerg is stronger before going all out.

The Zerg army only needs to maintain a certain offensive against the main city of the alien race. Now wanting to fight a quick battle may be counterproductive.

The Zerg can fight in the other three battlefields. It is not certain whether the races in the underground world are considered as foreign invading races. They can only be temporarily excluded and fight after the Zerg obtains the status of a large tribe.

The remaining demon race and desert race, Wu Qing chose the desert race with a relatively simpler situation.

The newly opened desert battlefield, except for the Naga tribe, is full of enemies. The Zerg can fight freely without any scruples.

Another important advantage of the desert battlefield is that it can fight all day without considering the influence of weirdness.

Having made a decision, Wu Qing immediately took action.

The third Zerg sub-base in the desert battlefield immediately established the fourth and fifth Zerg air force detachments according to the force configuration of the third Zerg air force detachment that was sweeping the desert.

The two powerful Zerg air force detachments were immediately dispatched to sweep different areas of the desert battlefield as soon as they were born.

The large number of desert oases and various desert race gathering places discovered by the Zerg need highly mobile and powerful Zerg air forces to clean up.

The three Zerg air forces fought at the same time, quickly clearing out the large gathering places of desert races one by one, and constantly consuming the war potential of the desert races.

The desert battlefield was full of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions. The system had enough gas resources. For this pair of partners, Wu Qing increased the proportion of the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

With enough three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, the pair's offensive capabilities have greatly increased. Many medium and small desert race gathering places can be cleared without the Zerg air force.

Under the powerful offensive of three Zerg air forces and overwhelming Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, the desert races, led by the desert lizards, began to take the initiative to attack without being fully prepared, gathering troops and killing towards the direction of the third Zerg sub-base.

The entire desert battlefield was boiling, and the scenes of the desert races fighting with Zerg puppies and three-type poisonous ray scorpions could be seen everywhere in the boundless desert.

In those areas where a large number of desert race troops were gathered, the Zerg air forces cooperated with the Zerg puppies and three-type poisonous ray scorpions on the ground to kill.

In the ancient desert territory, with the third Zerg sub-base as the center, a large area of desert area was caught in a melee.

There are more desert areas that the Zerg host has not explored, and countless desert race armies are gathering.

As the Zerg host explores the desert area more and more, Wu Qing feels that the current main combat force is still a little less.

The system's resources are being consumed, and they are also being earned in the war. With the resources accumulated originally, Wu Qing has no shortage of resources now.

Wu Qing has established two new air forces in the third Zerg sub-base in the desert battlefield, with the same force configuration as the previous three.

More than one million Zerg air main combat troops are participating in the war. Each Zerg air force has 10,000 five-star Zerg air guards and 10,000 five-star Zerg devourers, plus 500,000 Zerg flying dragons and various six-star Zerg auxiliary troops. The desert race army of tens of millions can't do anything to such a Zerg air force.

Five Zerg air forces of the same size attacked everywhere, and many desert races dared not to gather too many troops.

The desert race, frightened by the Zerg air force, began to change their strategy, gathering hundreds of thousands of troops everywhere, and each attacked in the direction of the third Zerg sub-base in the desert battlefield.

Facing the desert race army of hundreds of thousands, the Zerg air force could easily wipe them out, but the desert race army was too scattered and too many, even with the high mobility of the five Zerg air forces, they could not handle it all at once.

The Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions on the ground were immediately under great pressure. The desert battlefield was full of battles of hundreds of thousands and millions.

Facing this situation, the five Zerg air forces were divided into two, and then two into four, a total of twenty teams to support the ground operations.

The Zerg command system was too powerful, and the reorganization of the army was just a matter of thought.

With the support of twenty air forces, the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions fighting on the front line began to push the front line forward.

On the entire desert battlefield, the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were like locusts in a locust plague. Wherever they passed, the desert races who believed in evil gods were extinct, and wherever they were, they became the actual control area of the Zerg.

The third Zerg sub-base on the desert battlefield has also become the largest sub-base of the Zerg, sending a large number of troops to the desert battlefield every moment.

On the desert battlefield, the Zerg and the desert races have been fighting for a while. The desert races have finally assembled a terrible army in the rear area that the Zerg have not explored.

These assembled armies are not only numerous, but also the elite troops of each desert race.

In addition to one-star troops, two-star, three-star troops, and even higher-star troops can be seen everywhere.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

When the Zerg host discovered the ultimate army of the desert race, Wu Qing knew that the desert race had invested all the resources of each race.

Under the efficient sweep of the Zerg army, the desert race could not gather quickly. As soon as the army gathered in the front reached a certain number, it would be surrounded and annihilated by the Zerg air force and ground force.

The desert race paid a huge price and used the method of dispersing troops to attack, which delayed the Zerg army for some time and bought time for the assembly of the rear army.

Hundreds of millions of core armies of the desert race, stretching hundreds of thousands of kilometers, marched towards the direction of the third Zerg sub-base in the desert battlefield.

The six-star Zerg host sent by Wu Qing has discovered the seven-star troops accompanying the army, as well as stronger ones in secret.

This battle, the desert race cannot afford to lose.

The ancient desert territory where the desert battlefield is located is not small in area, but the environment is harsh. Except for a few races that can live in the deep desert, most desert races still need to rely on desert oases to live, and the total population is much smaller than other areas.

According to the current sweeping speed of the Zerg, it won't be long before the population of the desert race will be completely lost.

Therefore, the desert race will defeat the Zerg at all costs. Only in this way can they have a glimmer of hope.

The current military situation of the desert race is centered on the core army, with a large number of ordinary troops of hundreds of thousands as the vanguard, gradually advancing in the direction of the Zerg army.

Twenty Zerg air forces, in conjunction with the ubiquitous Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions on the ground, are constantly encircling and annihilating the vanguard troops of the desert race that are rushing up like they are sending themselves to death.

As long as it is an area occupied by the Zerg, it will be difficult for the desert race to take it back.

Most of the combat power of the general army of the desert race is not as good as the combination of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

Without the support of the Zerg air force, the Zerg Zerg Puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions, which are not at the star level, can make the star-level soldiers of the Desert Race unable to move, not to mention that most of the Desert Race's vanguard troops are ordinary soldiers that are not at the star level.

On a battlefield of such a scale, many of the Zerg Puppies and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions, which have been supported by the world rules and have become easier to improve their strength, have been upgraded to one star level on their own.

Even some soldiers who have fought for a long time have upgraded their strength to two stars on their own.

If such a war continues, more Zergs in the Zerg army will upgrade their star-level strength on their own. As long as the number of enemies killed is large enough, it is possible for some Zergs to upgrade their strength to the upper limit of the Zerg strength on their own.

…

The Desert Race's army is coming fiercely, and the Zerg Army's reinforcements are endless.

The battle lines of both sides have gradually become stalemates since the Zerg army quickly advanced. More and more vanguard troops of the Desert Race have gathered near the battle lines, and even if the Zerg air force keeps fighting, it seems a bit powerless.

As the core army of the desert race approached, the Zerg air force withdrew from the battle and gathered together to rest and wait.

The battle on the ground was handed over to the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion.

With the fearless sacrifice of the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion, the Zerg was able to defend against the attacks of all armies except the core army of the desert race.

The five Zerg air forces assembled together had a strength of nearly three million.

Among them were 50,000 five-star Zerg Sky Guardians, 50,000 five-star Zerg Devourers, 50 six-star Zerg Queens, 50 six-star Zerg Scorpions, 50 six-star Zerg Mammoths and 2.5 million Zerg Dragons.

Together with the Zerg Hosts and the emergency Zerg Exploding Mosquitoes, this was a very terrifying and powerful force, and they would be the main force against the core army of the desert race.

The Queen had already calculated the battle area between the Zerg Army and the core army of the desert race, and Wu Qing informed Naga of the situation here through Host No. 3.

"Elder, our tribe has received support from all the tribes, and we have sufficient manpower. We are now sweeping the desert battlefield!"

"In the desert battlefield, a large-scale decisive battle is about to come. Do you want to participate?"

This is an opportunity given by Wu Qing to the Naga tribe, as a reward for the Naga tribe's work in helping the Zerg tribe gain the status of a major tribe.
